title: chloris cruciata
intro: Chloris cruciata, commonly known as wind grass or finger grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its health benefits, which include its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Chloris cruciata include its use as a bronchodilator to relieve respiratory congestion and as an antipyretic to reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of Chloris cruciata include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
